data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Marcella, derived from Marcus, meaning 'Mars, god of war'. The name Marcela refers to a little warrior, a fighter, or a strong woman. The name Marcela carries the meaning “Little warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marcela usually hope their child will grow to embody little warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength and courage.
data.etymology: Marcela belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Marcela total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
data.cultural_impact: The name Marcela carries the legacy of the ancient Roman culture that has influenced Western civilization significantly. It evokes images of warrior women, such as Boudicca or Tomyris, who bravely fought against their enemies and protected their people. Introduced to the Christian world, this name became popular due to its association with strength, courage, and determination -- virtues that are highly valued in the faith.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Marcela can represent a woman of strong faith who fearlessly confronts trials and challenges in her life. She relies on her faith to guide her and trusts in God's providence and protection. In the face of adversity, Marcela embodies the qualities of resilience and perseverance, urging others to keep the faith and never give up. Her name serves as a reminder that even in the fiercest spiritual battles, there is always hope and strength to be found through faith in God.
